field.label: Enabled
field.help: Include this L2 reachability check in the CARP health decision.

field.label: Name
field.help: Unique descriptive name for this health check.

field.label: Interface
field.help: Logical OPNsense interface whose Layer 2 segment must reach the target.

field.label: IPv4 target
field.help: IPv4 address to probe with ARP on the selected interface. The probe does not consume a node-specific IPv4 address.

field.label: CARP scope
field.help: Global uses native CARP demotion. Specific VHID changes only that VHID on the selected interface.

field.label: VHID
field.help: Required for Specific VHID scope (1-255). Ignored for Global scope.
